scope: Additive Electro Owl L1-15 data correction and paired-Pet behavior audit. The raw Pet attack fields are retained; no incomplete Core actor is enabled.
game_version: Official L11-15 table published 2024-02-27; secondary full L1-15 table reports client build 18.400.21. Current 18.600.3 combat values and Pet AI timing were not verified.

sources.title: Meet The Hero Pets!
sources.levels: Pet House 2 onward; no numerical Pet levels in this article
facts: Electro Owl favors its Hero's target, can attack ground and air, moves at public speed 20, and fires a ranged attack that bounces once to a nearby target.
sources.limitations: The article omits Hero-linked spawn and follow timing, attack launch and impact, bounce radius, second-target priority, target loss and post-Hero-death behavior.

sources.title: February 2024 Update - Patch Notes
facts: The official table gives L11-15 hitpoints 2600, 2700, 2800, 2900, 3000 and DPS 150, 155, 160, 165, 170.
sources.limitations: The 2024 table does not prove these values were unchanged in the current TH18 build and does not publish damage per hit or chain-impact timing.

sources.title: Electro Owl
sources.version: client build 18.400.21, as reported by publisher
facts: The L1-15 hitpoint and DPS table agrees with the pinned raw payload; it describes the Pet as airborne and ground-and-air targeting.
sources.limitations: The page describes an older build and does not supply complete chain projectile, Hero following, acquisition or retargeting rules.

sources.title: Pinned Electro Owl Home Village Pet record
facts: The raw record stores damagePerSecond and damagePerHit at each Pet level, 1.4-second cadence, two targets and -20 chain damage decay.
sources.limitations: The pinned record does not identify a current client build or define chain distance, impact scheduling, Hero attachment or target-loss ordering.

derivations.result: Preserve the raw top-level Pet damagePerHit and damagePerSecond fields as catalogue damage_per_shot and dps
derivations.method: Lossless field normalization of the pinned raw Pet payload; no attack timing or Core actor is derived.

derivations.result: Pin official hitpoints and DPS independently of the raw table
derivations.method: Exact per-level values in the 2024 Supercell table; equal raw values receive explicit primary-source provenance.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply a fixed six-tile Owl attack range for every Hero pairing.
rejected_inferences.reason: The official Hero-target rule does not specify the effective range or Hero-follow geometry; secondary pages disagree on displayed range.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the shared chain-projectile route with a guessed bounce radius or launch delay.
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source provides the bounce distance, target tie-break, projectile speed, collision or impact order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the 2024 official L11-15 table and 18.400.21 secondary L1-15 table as proven unchanged in client build 18.600.3.
rejected_inferences.reason: No current-build Pet table or balance continuity record was found.

items: Hero-linked spawn, follow and post-Hero-death targeting
chain bounce radius, eligibility and deterministic second-target ordering
projectile speed, launch, impact and target-loss timing
air collision, visual anchors and legally redistributable battlefield art

conclusion: Electro Owl L1-15 remains partial and catalogue-only. The pinned damage fields and official L11-15 hitpoints and DPS are now preserved with provenance, while its paired chain-attack contract is too incomplete for a faithful Core, Headless, Viewer, RL, snapshot or replay implementation.
